title: Inflationary magnetogenesis from non-minimal coupling in large- and small-field potentials
summary: We investigate inflationary magnetogenesis in a scenario where conformal invariance of electromagnetism is broken through a \emph{non-minimal Yukawa-like coupling between the inflaton and the Ricci scalar}. We account for electromagnetic backreaction and the Schwinger effect, analyzing both standard single-field inflation and a generalized K-essence framework, \emph{dubbed quasi-quintessence}. We consider inflationary potentials compatible with Planck satellite constraints, including Starobinsky and $α$-attractor models for large fields, as well as hilltop scenarios for small fields.…
